h1: The 8 Best Countertop Dishwashers Under $400 for Small Kitchens, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 8 countertop dishwashers for under $400 compared on water tank, noise level, Energy Star status and wash programs.
summary: The COMFEE' Portable Mini with a 1.32 gallon tank and a 162°F wash is the countertop dishwasher to buy for most small kitchens. The EUHOMY with 360 degree spray and a listed 40 dB is the quiet pick, the Energy Star COMFEE' models suit couples, the AIRMSEN Large Slim is the biggest tank-fed option, and the NOVETE adds a baby-care cycle.
intro: Counter space is the hidden cost of a countertop dishwasher. These boxes look compact in a photo, but a six place setting unit takes up roughly the footprint of a large microwave, plus clearance for steam and a bowl or hose for drainage. Before you compare programs, measure the spot, the cabinet above it and the distance to the nearest outlet and sink.

We reviewed eight countertop dishwashers, all listed in the $200 to $500 range and chosen to stay under $400, and ranked them by spray design, wash temperature, listed noise, capacity and certification. Several listings are thin on numbers, and we mark those gaps instead of filling them. Price buckets stand in for exact prices.

products.name: COMFEE' Portable Mini Dishwasher Countertop with 1.32Gal Built-in Water
products.verdict: Six programs, dual spray arms and a 162°F wash with air-dry, with room left in a $400 budget.
products.description:
The COMFEE' Mini carries a 1.32 gallon built-in water tank, six wash programs, 360 degree dual spray arms and a 162°F high-temperature wash cycle with an air-dry step. No faucet hookup is involved, since you fill the tank yourself.

The spray design and the hot wash are why this comes out on top. Dual arms throw water from two angles, which helps with baked-on residue on plates, and a wash near 162°F loosens grease that a lukewarm rinse leaves behind. Finishing with air-dry means you are not hunting for a towel. What you give up is volume: a small tank means small loads, and dinner for a family needs two runs.

Pick it if you live alone or as a pair, and want the most complete feature set in the cheapest tier. Pass on it if you want one-cycle capacity for four people.
pros: Dual spray arms reach more surfaces
products.idealFor: One or two people in a small kitchen.
products.skipIf: You wash for a family of four.

products.name: EUHOMY 6 Programs Countertop Dishwasher Portable, 40dB, 360° Coverage
products.verdict: A 40 dB rating, six programs and 360 degree spray in a no-hookup box.
products.description:
This EUHOMY lists six wash programs, a 40 dB noise rating and 360 degree spray coverage, in a countertop design that needs no hookup. It is the quieter of the two EUHOMY models in the group, with the extra detail on spray coverage.

Noise gets less attention than it deserves. In a studio or a shared flat, a dishwasher on the counter sits within a few metres of where you sleep or work, and a machine rated around 40 dB is far less intrusive than a louder one. The 360 degree spray claim adds confidence that the interior is covered. It trails the COMFEE' Mini only because the listing says nothing about water temperature.

Get it when quiet matters and the dishes are everyday plates, bowls and cups. Read how the water is supplied before ordering, as the listing only confirms no hookup.
pros: Rated at 40 dB for quiet use
cons: Noise rating comes from the seller
products.idealFor: Studios and shared spaces where noise matters.
products.skipIf: You need a stated high-temperature wash.

products.name: COMFEE' Countertop Dishwasher, Energy Star Portable Dishwasher, 6 Place
products.verdict: A black, Energy Star certified unit with six place settings and the biggest program list.
products.description:
This COMFEE' model is Energy Star certified, holds six place settings and comes in a black finish. It offers the most wash programs among the countertop picks here.

Capacity is the draw. Six place settings is a recognised measure, equal to six dinner plates, six bowls and the cups and cutlery that go with them, so a couple can clear a dinner in one cycle. The Energy Star certificate is a verified efficiency mark, which matters because a dishwasher uses both water and power. The listing does not spell out whether it needs a faucet hose or a fill-by-hand tank, so confirm that before you commit.

Choose it for a two-person home and a counter wide enough for a larger box. Skip it for a dorm shelf, where a mini fits better.
products.skipIf: Your counter is narrow or shallow.

products.name: EUHOMY Countertop Dishwasher Portable, 6 Programs with 40 dB, No Hookup
products.verdict: The same six programs and 40 dB listing at a lower spend, with no hookup.
products.description:
This second EUHOMY lists six wash programs, a 40 dB noise level and a no-hookup countertop design. It is aimed at buyers who want to stay well under the $400 limit.

Its position behind the 360 degree model comes from detail, not from the headline numbers. The listing does not describe spray coverage, so you cannot judge how thoroughly it reaches the corners of the rack. Both machines promise the same quiet, and if the price gap is real, this one is the economical way to get it.

Take it when the budget matters more than extra spray detail. If the two EUHOMY units cost nearly the same, buy the 360 degree version.
products.idealFor: Budget buyers who want quiet operation.
products.skipIf: You want spray coverage stated on the listing.

products.name: COMFEE' Countertop Dishwasher Portable, 6 Place Settings, Energy Star
products.verdict: Energy Star and six place settings with straightforward controls.
products.description:
This COMFEE' is the plainer sibling of the black model. It is Energy Star certified, holds six place settings, and uses simple controls, with a countertop portable body.

Simple controls are an underrated virtue for anyone who wants to press one button and walk away. Fewer programs mean fewer decisions, and the same six place capacity keeps it practical for couples. The tradeoff is less flexibility than the program-heavy black model, and a listing that gives little on water supply or noise.

Select it when you want certified efficiency and a no-fuss panel. Choose the black model instead if you like to match a cycle to each load.
products.skipIf: You like a program for every load.

products.name: AIRMSEN Large Slim Countertop Dishwasher | Built-in Water Tank
products.verdict: A slim countertop machine with a built-in tank and the biggest capacity in the group.
products.description:
The AIRMSEN Large Slim is a countertop portable machine with a built-in water tank. The listing positions it as having the largest capacity here, for households that have outgrown a mini-tank unit.

The slim shape is its practical edge on a crowded counter, as a tall narrow body takes less room than a wide one. A built-in tank removes the need for a faucet connection. The caution is detail: no capacity figure, program count or noise level appears on the listing, so the claim of largest cannot be checked.

Consider it when counter width is the limit and you want the bigger of the tank-fed options. Look at the product page for real dimensions before you buy.
pros: Fits a household that outgrew a mini
products.idealFor: Households that outgrew a mini dishwasher.
products.skipIf: You want specs you can verify.

products.name: NOVETE Portable Countertop Dishwashers, Compact Dishwashers with 5L
products.verdict: A compact 5L unit with an air-dry function, LED indicator light and a baby-care cycle.
products.description:
The NOVETE is a compact countertop dishwasher with a 5L tank, an air-dry function and an LED indicator light. Its standout feature for parents is a dedicated baby-care cycle.

A baby-care cycle targets bottles, pacifiers and small parts, which are awkward to hand wash and which parents wash daily. The air-dry function saves a step, and the light shows you at a glance whether a cycle is running. The 5L tank limits how much goes in, so it is not the machine for full dinner plates and pans.

Get it if the main job is baby gear and small items. Pass on it if you want a general family dishwasher.
products.idealFor: Parents washing bottles and small parts.
products.skipIf: You want to wash full dinner loads.

products.name: AIRMSEN Portable Countertop Dishwasher, No Hookup Needed
products.verdict: A no-hookup, built-in tank countertop dishwasher at slightly bigger capacity.
products.description:
This AIRMSEN has a no-hookup, built-in tank design in a countertop form. The listing says it offers slightly bigger capacity than the mini-tank units.

The design is simple and works: fill the tank, run the cycle, drain the water afterwards. That simplicity is also the limitation, since the listing shares no programs, no noise level and no certification, so it sits last on documented value. The slim sibling has the same gap, but at least positions itself clearly as the largest.

Opt for it when you need a basic tank-fed machine and the price is right. Compare it with the COMFEE' Mini, which lists a hot wash and dual spray.
products.idealFor: Basic no-plumbing washing on a budget.
products.skipIf: You want a listed hot wash or programs.

methodology.title: Spray and wash design
methodology.description: Dual spray arms, 360 degree coverage and the 162°F wash were weighed first, since they decide how clean the dishes come out.

methodology.title: Capacity
methodology.description: Place settings, tank sizes from 1.32 gallons to 5L and the largest-capacity claims were compared across the group.

methodology.title: Noise
methodology.description: Units listing 40 dB were ranked above those that say nothing, because quiet matters on a counter.

methodology.title: Certification and programs
methodology.description: Energy Star marks and the number of named programs, including the baby-care cycle, were treated as evidence of design effort.

methodology.title: Spec transparency
methodology.description: Listings that disclose water supply, noise and capacity ranked above those that leave the details out.

whatMatters.detail: A countertop unit needs the box size plus space for steam and the drain. Measure width, depth and the gap to the cabinet above. If a listing does not give dimensions, ask in the questions section before ordering.
Tank-fed units need you to fill them each time, while hose units pull from the faucet. A tank gives you flexibility, a hose gives you volume. Read for built-in water tank or no hookup in the title.

Dishes come clean from hot water moving fast across them. Dual arms and 360 degree spray improve coverage, and a 162°F wash cuts grease. A listing that mentions neither is leaving out the facts that matter most.
A decibel figure turns a vague promise into something checkable. 40 dB is quiet for the category. Most listings omit it, so a stated number is a point in the unit's favor.
Six programs cover quick, eco and heavy washes. A baby-care cycle adds a hot setting for bottles. Do not pay for programs you will never press, but do look for a quick cycle for light loads.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: No hookup, a built-in tank, a small footprint and a hot wash. Avoid units that need a faucet adapter and a drain hose.

cards.text: The COMFEE' Portable Mini for its tank and hot wash, and the AIRMSEN Portable Countertop for a basic no-hookup alternative.

cards.text: You wash for two or more daily. The Energy Star COMFEE' models and the 360 degree EUHOMY give more capacity and detail.

faq.q: Can a countertop dishwasher work without plumbing?
faq.a: Yes, the tank-fed models here work without a hookup. You pour water into a built-in tank, run a cycle and empty the dirty water. Units like the COMFEE' Mini and both AIRMSEN models use this method.

faq.q: What mistake do buyers make most often?
faq.a: Forgetting the counter. A countertop dishwasher needs more room than the picture suggests, plus clearance above for steam. Measure, and check that the door can open without hitting a cabinet.

faq.q: Is a six place setting unit worth it over a mini?
faq.a: For two people who cook, yes, because one cycle covers a full dinner. For one person with few dishes, a mini saves counter space and money.
Easy for tank models: level surface, outlet, fill the tank, run a cycle. Hose models need a faucet adapter. Run an empty cycle first to rinse out any factory residue.

faq.q: Do I need to pre-rinse dishes?
faq.a: Scrape food off but skip the full rinse. Small machines have limited filters, so large scraps can clog them. A 162°F wash handles light residue without a pre-rinse.

faq.q: How do I stop the machine from smelling?
faq.a: Empty and wipe the filter after each use, leave the door slightly open to dry, and run a cleaning cycle occasionally. Standing water in a tank is the usual cause of bad smells.

finalTake: For most small kitchens, the COMFEE' Portable Mini is the best countertop dishwasher under $400, with a tank, six programs, dual spray and a 162°F wash. The 360 degree EUHOMY is the pick when noise matters, the Energy Star COMFEE' models suit couples, and the NOVETE handles baby bottles. Measure your counter before you compare any features.
